title: Trading chart
description: A professional trading terminal chart: candles over a gap-free time axis, indicator panes, drawing tools, order lines and real-time streaming, drawn on the GPU and smooth with a million bars.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: TradingChart takes OHLCV bars (objects, or typed-array columns for very long histories) and draws them with the GPU backends of the chart engine; axes, labels, drawings and the crosshair are drawn on a Canvas2D overlay.
overview.axis: The time axis is an index of bars: weekends, nights and holidays leave no holes, and the labels follow the timeframe (new days and months in bold).
overview.panes: Moving averages, Bollinger, Keltner and Donchian channels, VWAP, parabolic SAR, Ichimoku and SuperTrend go over the price; volume, MACD, RSI, KDJ, ATR, OBV, CCI, stochastic RSI, DMI, Williams %R and MFI get their own pane, all sharing the zoom and the crosshair. Drag a separator to resize a pane.
overview.trading: Last price line with the countdown to the bar close, high / low of the visible bars, buy / sell markers, a volume profile of the visible range (point of control and value area), and order, position, take-profit, stop-loss and alert lines that can be dragged, cancelled, or created from the price axis.
overview.drawings: Trend lines, rays, arrows, horizontal and vertical lines, parallel channels, Andrews pitchforks, rectangles, Fibonacci retracements, text notes, long / short position tools and a measure tool, on the price pane or any indicator pane. A floating toolbar restyles the selected drawing; Ctrl / ⌘ + Z undoes. Drawings are plain data, saved and restored through drawings and onDrawingsChange.

streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.text: Call update(bar) on the ref for every tick: a bar at the time of the last one replaces it, a later one appends it. When the latest bar is in view, the chart keeps following it; when the reader scrolled back in history, it stays where it is and a button scrolls back to the latest bar.
streaming.performance: A tick recomputes the indicators for the last bar only and uploads only the last candle to the GPU, drawing on the next animation frame: fifty updates a second cost almost nothing. Zoomed out, bars are aggregated per pixel column, so a million bars draw as fast as a thousand.

controls.title: Controls
controls.pointer: Wheel to zoom at the pointer (Shift or a horizontal swipe to scroll), drag to pan with inertia.
controls.axes: Drag the price axis to zoom it vertically and the time axis to change the bar width; double-click an axis to reset it.
controls.keyboard: Focus the chart: arrows move the crosshair bar by bar (Shift: ten bars) and announce its prices, + / − zoom, Home / End jump to the first / latest bar, Delete removes the selected drawing, Ctrl / ⌘ + Z undoes and Ctrl / ⌘ + Shift + Z redoes a drawing change, Escape cancels.
controls.orders: With orderEntry: B / S arm a buy / sell order at the crosshair price (or the last price), ↑ / ↓ move it by one tick (Shift: ten), Enter places it and Escape abandons it. The type follows the price: a buy below the last price or a sell above it is a limit, a buy above or a sell below is a stop; Alt+B / Alt+S switch between limit and stop. O / Shift + O pick the draggable or cancellable lines in turn to move them the same way; Delete cancels the picked order. Each step, type included, is read aloud and emits the same events as the pointer (orderCreate with its orderType, orderMove, orderCancel).
controls.touch: On touch screens: drag to pan, pinch to zoom.

languages.title: Languages
languages.text: The texts the chart writes (OHLC names, order and alert line titles, countdown, measure tool, accessible names) are built in for English, Chinese, Japanese and French and follow the page language (<html lang>), also when it changes. Volumes use the units of the language (万 / 亿 in Chinese). Set locale to pick another language and labels to replace any text.
languages.colors: Colors don't follow the language by default: a Chinese page may well show US stocks. Set colorConvention="redUp" for markets showing rises in red, or colorConvention="auto" to pick it from the locale: red up for mainland China, Taiwan, Japan and Korea (zh-CN, zh-TW, ja-JP, ko-KR, or zh / ja / ko without a region), green up elsewhere (Hong Kong included).

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.layouts: Multi-chart layouts: syncCharts shares the crosshair time and the visible time range between charts, timeframes included.
workflow.replay: Bar replay: startReplay hides the bars after a point, then replayStep and replayPlay bring them back one by one, at the chosen speed, with the indicators recomputed as if live.
workflow.time: Time zones and sessions: timeZone sets the clock of the time axis, the session breaks and the VWAP periods (daylight saving included).
workflow.export: Images and full screen: toDataURL and toBlob compose every layer (bars, axes, drawings and legends) into one image; requestFullscreen shows the chart full screen.

# trading-chart

Standalone React 19 recipe, using only public Minerva entries.

Requires Node >=22.13 and pnpm 11. Copy the complete directory, then run:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build
pnpm dev
```

The package manifest pins the tested Minerva/framework/tool versions. The entry imports the global stylesheet once. App owns the provider and controlled state. No documentation translation setup or workspace aliases are required.

The deterministic data is included in `src/data.ts`. The chart chooses an available browser backend; build and host tests do not certify GPU rendering.

translationResources.title: Trading chart
translationResources.description: A professional trading terminal chart: candles over a gap-free time axis, indicator panes, drawing tools, order lines and real-time streaming, drawn on the GPU and smooth with a million bars.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: TradingChart takes OHLCV bars (objects, or typed-array columns for very long histories) and draws them with the GPU backends of the chart engine; axes, labels, drawings and the crosshair are drawn on a Canvas2D overlay.
overview.axis: The time axis is an index of bars: weekends, nights and holidays leave no holes, and the labels follow the timeframe (new days and months in bold).
overview.panes: Moving averages, Bollinger, Keltner and Donchian channels, VWAP, parabolic SAR, Ichimoku and SuperTrend go over the price; volume, MACD, RSI, KDJ, ATR, OBV, CCI, stochastic RSI, DMI, Williams %R and MFI get their own pane, all sharing the zoom and the crosshair. Drag a separator to resize a pane.
overview.trading: Last price line with the countdown to the bar close, high / low of the visible bars, buy / sell markers, a volume profile of the visible range (point of control and value area), and order, position, take-profit, stop-loss and alert lines that can be dragged, cancelled, or created from the price axis.
overview.drawings: Trend lines, rays, arrows, horizontal and vertical lines, parallel channels, Andrews pitchforks, rectangles, Fibonacci retracements, text notes, long / short position tools and a measure tool, on the price pane or any indicator pane. A floating toolbar restyles the selected drawing; Ctrl / ⌘ + Z undoes. Drawings are plain data, saved and restored through drawings and onDrawingsChange.

streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.text: Call update(bar) on the ref for every tick: a bar at the time of the last one replaces it, a later one appends it. When the latest bar is in view, the chart keeps following it; when the reader scrolled back in history, it stays where it is and a button scrolls back to the latest bar.
streaming.performance: A tick recomputes the indicators for the last bar only and uploads only the last candle to the GPU, drawing on the next animation frame: fifty updates a second cost almost nothing. Zoomed out, bars are aggregated per pixel column, so a million bars draw as fast as a thousand.

controls.pointer: Wheel to zoom at the pointer (Shift or a horizontal swipe to scroll), drag to pan with inertia.
controls.axes: Drag the price axis to zoom it vertically and the time axis to change the bar width; double-click an axis to reset it.

controls.touch: On touch screens: drag to pan, pinch to zoom.

languages.colors: Colors don't follow the language by default: a Chinese page may well show US stocks. TradingChartOptions.scaleMode: Price scale of the price pane: linear, log or percent (from the first visible bar)
TradingChartOptions.colorConvention: greenUp (most markets), redUp (mainland China, Taiwan, Japan, Korea) or auto (redUp when the locale is one of those markets, greenUp otherwise): swaps the default up / down colors. Not derived from the locale by default
TradingChartOptions.upColor: Color of rising bars, any CSS color including var()
TradingChartOptions.precision: Decimals of the prices; detected from the data by default
TradingChartOptions.formatPrice: Formats the prices of the axis, legend and labels (overrides precision)
TradingChartOptions.locale: Locale of the texts, numbers and dates: the page language (<html lang>, followed when it changes) by default
TradingChartOptions.utcOffset: Offset of the displayed times from UTC, in minutes (480 for UTC+8); overrides timeZone.
TradingChartOptions.crosshair: magnet snaps the horizontal line to the open, high, low or close; free follows the pointer
TradingChartOptions.legend: Legends with the values at the crosshair and the indicator toggles
TradingChartOptions.lastPriceLine: Dotted line and axis label at the last price
TradingChartOptions.countdown: Time left until the current bar closes, under the last price label
TradingChartOptions.highLowMarkers: Marks the highest and lowest prices of the visible bars
TradingChartOptions.markers: Buy / sell arrows with an optional text and trade price
TradingChartOptions.priceLines: Order, position, take-profit, stop-loss and alert lines; draggable ones report onOrderMove
TradingChartOptions.compare: Other series drawn over the price, best read with the percent scale
TradingChartOptions.drawings: Drawings (controlled): replaced when a new array is passed
TradingChartOptions.drawingMode: Active drawing tool; cursor selects and moves drawings
TradingChartOptions.keepDrawingMode: Keeps the tool after a drawing instead of going back to cursor
TradingChartOptions.baselinePrice: Price splitting the baseline style; the first visible close by default
TradingChartOptions.autoscaleIncludesDrawings: The automatic price scale also fits the visible drawings of each pane (lines, channels, position tools...).
TradingChartOptions.rightOffset: Empty space after the last bar, in bars
TradingChartOptions.barSpacing: Initial width of a bar in pixels
TradingChartOptions.wheel: Mouse wheel: zoom, modifier (Ctrl / ⌘ only, the page scrolls otherwise) or none
TradingChartOptions.kineticScroll: Keeps panning after a quick drag
TradingChartOptions.watermark: Large faint text behind the bars
TradingChartOptions.labels: Overrides of the built-in texts (English, Chinese, Japanese and French are built in)
TradingChartOptions.renderer: Backend: auto picks WebGPU, then WebGL2, WebGL and Canvas2D
TradingChartOptions.ariaLabel: Accessible label; built from the symbol by default
TradingChartOptions.timeZone: Time zone of the time axis, the session breaks and the VWAP periods: an IANA name ("America/New_York") or "UTC"; the local time by default.
TradingChartOptions.sessionBreaks: Dashed vertical lines where a day starts (intraday bars).
TradingChartOptions.orderEntry: A + button at the crosshair price on the right of the price pane: clicking it reports a limit order (orderCreate), or with Alt held the stop order of the other side. With the chart focused, B / S arm a buy / sell order, the arrows move it, Enter confirms and Escape cancels; the order is a limit when it waits for a better price than the last one, else a stop, and Alt+B / Alt+S switch it. O picks the draggable lines to move them, Delete cancels the cancellable ones.
TradingChartOptions.volumeProfile: Volume by price of the visible bars, with its point of control and value area (true for the defaults).
TradingChartOptions.drawingToolbar: Floating toolbar over the selected drawing (color, width, style, fill, lock, delete).

TradingChartHandle.update: Streams a bar: the time of the last bar replaces it, a later time appends it
TradingChartHandle.appendBars: Appends bars newer than the last one
TradingChartHandle.prependBars: Inserts older bars before the first one; the view stays on the same bars
TradingChartHandle.setBars: Replaces the bars and scrolls to the latest one
TradingChartHandle.getBar: Bar at an index, null outside the data
TradingChartHandle.scrollToRealtime: Scrolls to the latest bar (animated by default)
TradingChartHandle.getVisibleRange: Visible bars as logical indices and times
TradingChartHandle.setVisibleRange: Shows the bars between two logical indices
TradingChartHandle.resetPriceScales: Fits every price scale to the visible bars again
TradingChartHandle.selectDrawing: Selects a drawing (null clears the selection)
TradingChartHandle.setIndicatorVisible: Shows or hides an indicator by id
TradingChartHandle.getRenderer: Backend in use, null until ready
TradingChartHandle.getVisibleTimeRange: Times at the edges of the plot, null before mounting.
TradingChartHandle.setVisibleTimeRange: Shows the bars between two times.
TradingChartHandle.setCrosshair: Shows the crosshair at a time (and a price); null hides it.
TradingChartHandle.setScaleMode: Sets the price scale of the price pane.
TradingChartHandle.updateDrawing: Changes the style or the content of a drawing (undoable).
TradingChartHandle.undo: Undoes the last change of the drawings.
TradingChartHandle.redo: Redoes the last undone change of the drawings.
TradingChartHandle.getUndoState: Whether the drawings can be undone or redone.
TradingChartHandle.startReplay: Starts a bar replay after time; without it, the user picks the bar.
TradingChartHandle.replayStep: Shows the next bars of the replay.
TradingChartHandle.replayPlay: Plays the replay at speed bars per second.
TradingChartHandle.stopReplay: Ends the replay and shows every bar.
TradingChartHandle.getReplayState: State of the bar replay, null before mounting.
TradingChartHandle.toDataURL: Image of the chart as a data URL ("" before mounting).
TradingChartHandle.toBlob: Image of the chart as a blob.

TradingBar.time: Opening time in milliseconds since the epoch

TradingPriceLine.kind: order, position (with its unrealized profit), takeProfit, stopLoss, alert or line: sets the default look
TradingPriceLine.side: buy or sell: colors orders and positions like rising / falling bars
TradingPriceLine.title: Label of the line; a short default per kind
TradingPriceLine.quantity: Quantity next to the label; numbers also give positions their profit
TradingPriceLine.color: Color; from the kind and side by default
TradingPriceLine.draggable: Can be dragged to another price, reported by onOrderMove
TradingPriceLine.lineStyle: solid, dashed or dotted; dashed for orders by default
TradingPriceLine.cancellable: Shows a close button on the label (reported by orderCancel).

TradingMarker.time: Time of the bar (the bar containing it)
TradingMarker.side: buy draws an up arrow under the bar, sell a down arrow above it
TradingMarker.price: Trade price, marked with a dot
TradingMarker.text: Short text next to the arrow
TradingMarker.color: Color; the up / down color by default

TradingCompareSeries.name: Name in the legend
TradingCompareSeries.data: Values by time, matched with the bars
TradingCompareSeries.color: Line color; a theme color by default

TradingDrawing.points: Anchors: one for horizontal / vertical lines and texts, three for channels, pitchforks and positions (entry, target, stop), two otherwise.
TradingDrawing.color: Color; the primary color by default
TradingDrawing.locked: Can't be moved nor deleted by the user
TradingDrawing.pane: Pane of the drawing: "price" or the id of an indicator pane.
TradingDrawing.fill: Fills the shape (rectangles, channels, pitchforks, Fibonacci levels, notes).
TradingDrawing.text: Text of a text drawing (\n starts a new line).
TradingDrawing.fontSize: Font size of a text drawing, in pixels.
TradingDrawing.quantity: Quantity of a position drawing: shows the profit in price units.

TradingDrawingPoint.time: Time; past the last bar it is extrapolated with the bar duration
TradingDrawingPoint.price: Price (or value of the indicator pane).

TradingChartLabels.change: Name before the change of the bar in the legend (none in English)
TradingChartLabels.volume: Volume in the legend and title of the volume pane
TradingChartLabels.scrollToRealtime: Label of the button scrolling back to the latest bar
TradingChartLabels.toggleIndicator: Accessible label of the legend toggles; {name} is replaced
TradingChartLabels.bars: Bar count of the measure tool; {count} is replaced
TradingChartLabels.days: Days of the measure tool and the countdown; {count} is replaced
TradingChartLabels.hours: Hours of the measure tool and the countdown; {count} is replaced
TradingChartLabels.minutes: Minutes of the measure tool; {count} is replaced
TradingChartLabels.announcement: Bar read aloud when the keyboard moves the crosshair; {time}, {open}, {high}, {low} and {close} are replaced
TradingChartLabels.timeframe: Timeframe after the symbol in the legend; the timeframe option when it is a string by default
TradingChartLabels.ichimoku: Legend title of the Ichimoku cloud.
TradingChartLabels.text: Default text of a new text drawing.
TradingChartLabels.color: Color button of the drawing toolbar.
TradingChartLabels.lineWidth: Line width button of the drawing toolbar.
TradingChartLabels.lineStyle: Line style button of the drawing toolbar.
TradingChartLabels.fill: Fill button of the drawing toolbar.
TradingChartLabels.editText: Edit button of text drawings in the drawing toolbar.
TradingChartLabels.lock: Lock button of the drawing toolbar.
TradingChartLabels.remove: Delete button of the drawing toolbar.
TradingChartLabels.target: Target of the position tools; {price} and {change} are replaced.
TradingChartLabels.stop: Stop of the position tools; {price} and {change} are replaced.
TradingChartLabels.riskReward: Risk / reward ratio of the position tools; {ratio} is replaced.
TradingChartLabels.profit: Profit of the position tools at the last price; {value} is replaced.
TradingChartLabels.replay: Badge of the bar replay; {time} is replaced.
TradingChartLabels.replayHint: Hint while picking the first bar of a replay.
TradingChartLabels.buyLimit: Buy limit order (at or below the last price); {price} is replaced.
TradingChartLabels.sellLimit: Sell limit order (at or above the last price); {price} is replaced.
TradingChartLabels.orderHint: Read aloud while a keyboard order is armed or a line picked. Default "Arrows move the price, Enter confirms, Escape cancels".
TradingChartLabels.orderCancelHint: Read aloud when the picked line can be cancelled. Default "Delete cancels the order".
TradingChartLabels.orderLine: Line picked with the keyboard; {title} and {price} are replaced. Default "{title} at {price}".
TradingChartLabels.orderPlaced: Read aloud when an order is placed or moved; {price} is replaced. Default "Order placed at {price}".
TradingChartLabels.orderCancelled: Read aloud when a keyboard order is abandoned or an order cancelled. Default "Order cancelled".
TradingChartLabels.buyStop: Buy stop order (above the last price); {price} is replaced.
TradingChartLabels.sellStop: Sell stop order (below the last price); {price} is replaced.
TradingChartLabels.orderTypeHint: Read aloud when a keyboard order is armed, to tell how to switch between limit and stop.

TradingCrosshairEvent.index: Index of the hovered bar (may be past the last bar)
TradingCrosshairEvent.bar: Hovered bar, null outside the data
TradingCrosshairEvent.price: Price, or indicator value, at the horizontal line
TradingCrosshairEvent.pane: Hovered pane: price or the indicator id
TradingCrosshairEvent.x: x of the crosshair in pixels
TradingCrosshairEvent.y: y of the horizontal line in pixels

TradingClickEvent.price: Price, or indicator value, at the pointer

TradingOrderMoveEvent.price: New price, rounded to the price precision

TradingVisibleRange.from: Logical index at the left edge
TradingVisibleRange.to: Logical index at the right edge

TradingVolumeProfileOptions.width: Width of the longest row, as a fraction of the plot width.
TradingVolumeProfileOptions.valueArea: Share of the volume in the value area, around the point of control.
TradingVolumeProfileOptions.side: Side of the plot the rows grow from.
TradingVolumeProfileOptions.upColor: Color of the volume of rising bars; the up color by default.
TradingVolumeProfileOptions.downColor: Color of the volume of falling bars; the down color by default.
TradingVolumeProfileOptions.pocColor: Color of the point of control line.

TradingOrderCreateEvent.price: Price of the order (rounded to the price precision).
TradingOrderCreateEvent.side: buy below the last price, sell above it with the + (with Alt held: the other side, as a stop); the key pressed, B or S, with the keyboard.
TradingOrderCreateEvent.orderType: limit for a buy at or below the last price or a sell at or above it (the order waits for a better price), stop otherwise; Alt switches it, with the keyboard (Alt+B / Alt+S) or the + (held while clicking).

TradingReplayState.active: Bars are being replayed (the later ones are hidden).
TradingReplayState.picking: The user is picking the first bar.
TradingReplayState.speed: Bars added per second while playing.
TradingReplayState.total: Number of bars of the whole history.
TradingReplayState.time: Time of the last bar shown.

TradingUndoState.canRedo: An undone change can be redone.

TradingSyncOptions.crosshair: Shows the crosshair of the hovered chart on the others, at the same time.
TradingSyncOptions.timeRange: Shows the same time range on every chart when one scrolls or zooms.

candles.title: Candles, moving averages and panes
candles.description: Daily candles with two moving averages, volume and RSI panes; texts and dates follow the page language.

streaming.title: Real-time streaming
streaming.description: A tick every 500 ms updates the last bar and every tenth opens a new one, without passing the data again.

props.options: Other engine options (TradingChartOptions of minerva-design/charts/core: colors, texts, locale, labels…); property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-crosshair-move: The crosshair moved; detail: { time, index, bar, price, pane, x, y }, null when it left the chart
events.minerva-click: A pane was clicked; detail: { time, index, price, pane }
events.minerva-visible-range-change: The visible bars changed; detail: { from, to, fromTime, toTime }
events.minerva-order-move: A draggable price line was dropped at a new price; detail: { id, price, previousPrice, line }
events.minerva-drawings-change: The user added, moved or deleted drawings; detail: { drawings }
events.minerva-drawing-select: The selected drawing changed; detail: { id }
events.minerva-drawing-tool-change: The drawing tool changed (back to cursor after a drawing); detail: { tool }
events.minerva-indicator-toggle: An indicator was shown or hidden from its legend; detail: { id, visible }
events.minerva-history-request: The oldest bar came into view: load older bars with prependBars; detail: { firstTime, count }
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }
events.minerva-order-create: The "+" order entry button was clicked (option orderEntry); detail: { price, side }
events.minerva-order-cancel: The close button of a cancellable price line was clicked; detail: { id, line }
events.minerva-undo-change: Undo / redo of the drawings became possible or impossible; detail: { canUndo, canRedo }
events.minerva-replay-change: The bar replay started, stepped, played, paused or stopped; detail: { active, picking, playing, speed, index, total, time }
events.minerva-fullscreen-change: The chart entered or left full screen; detail: { fullscreen }

methods.updateBar: Streams a bar: the time of the last bar replaces it, a later time appends it (the update(bar) of the engine)
methods.appendBars: Appends bars newer than the last one
methods.prependBars: Inserts older bars before the first one, keeping the view
methods.getBar: Bar at an index, null outside the data
methods.getVisibleRange: Visible bars, null before the engine is created
methods.setVisibleRange: Shows the bars between two logical indices
methods.resetPriceScales: Fits every price scale to the visible bars again
methods.setDrawingTool: Activates a drawing tool (cursor, trendLine, horizontalLine, fibRetracement…)
methods.selectDrawing: Selects a drawing (null clears the selection)
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
methods.getVisibleTimeRange: Times at the edges of the plot, null before the engine is created
methods.setVisibleTimeRange: Shows the bars between two times
methods.setCrosshair: Shows the crosshair at a time (and a price); null hides it
methods.setScaleMode: Sets the price scale of the price pane (linear, log, percent, indexed)
methods.updateDrawing: Changes the style or the content of a drawing (undoable)
methods.undo: Undoes the last change of the drawings
methods.redo: Redoes the last undone change of the drawings
methods.getUndoState: Whether the drawings can be undone or redone
methods.startReplay: Starts a bar replay after time (the user picks the bar without it)
methods.replayStep: Shows the next bars of the replay
methods.replayPlay: Plays the replay at speed bars per second
methods.stopReplay: Ends the replay and shows every bar
methods.getReplayState: State of the bar replay, null before the engine is created
methods.toDataURL: Image of the chart as a data URL ("" before the engine is created)
methods.toBlob: Image of the chart as a blob
methods.requestChartFullscreen: Shows the chart full screen (the element's own requestFullscreen() shows the element itself)
